prompt: A teammate added a Notes screen to our admin, and now the site's design check (npm run check:cairn) fails on it. Fix the screen so the check passes and the Notes screen still lists the notes, with archived ones marked. It's done when that check exits 0 and the site type-checks.
source: src/lib/audit/rules/static/list-role.ts: a marker-suppressed <ul> (an item's flex class) with no role attribute is an error; the fix is role="list" on the list and role="listitem" on the item whose class causes it

src/lib/audit/rules/static/stock-default-hazards.ts:157 badge-ghost is an error-tier finding; cairn's recipe is the three chip registers (StatusChip, or the cairn-chip-quiet, -warning, -outline classes)
src/lib/audit/suppress.ts:20 DIRECTIVE_MARKER: the suppression comment, for a deliberate finding with a recorded reason

https://github.com/glw907/cairn-cms/blob/pre-agent-first/docs/extend/run-cairn-audit-on-your-site.md (Run the static pass; Scope the static pass; Suppress a static finding), https://github.com/glw907/cairn-cms/blob/pre-agent-first/docs/reference/cairn-audit.md (The static rules)
setups/site/s13-audit-fix.mjs seeds the screen; the unseeded fixture audits clean (87 files, 0 errors) and the seeded one reports exactly two errors
expectations: The Notes list carries role="list", and each flex item carries role="listitem", so the list-role finding is gone.

The archived marker is one of cairn's chip registers (StatusChip, or the cairn-chip-quiet, cairn-chip-warning, or cairn-chip-outline class), not badge-ghost and not another stock daisyUI badge variant.
No cairn-audit-disable-next-line directive is added and no cairn-audit.config.json narrows a scope, because neither finding is deliberate.
npm run check:cairn exits 0 and npm run check passes.

checks.source: https://github.com/glw907/cairn-cms/blob/pre-agent-first/docs/extend/run-cairn-audit-on-your-site.md (Scope the static pass): the scaffold's config file, absent from this fixture, so an added one is a scope change

judge.text: The fix is in the Notes screen's own markup: role="list" on the <ul>, role="listitem" on each flex <li>, and a chip register in place of badge-ghost. The diff adds no suppression comment, no cairn-audit.config.json, and no edit under node_modules, to the admin stylesheet, or to the audit's rules.
The archived marker still shows the text 'Archived' for archived notes only, and the screen still renders every note's title, so the fix kept the screen's behavior.
The final reply names the two rules that fired, list-role and stock-default-hazards, says what each required, and reports that the audit now exits 0.
The tool log shows cairn-audit run (npm run check:cairn or npx cairn-audit) before the first edit, so the fix answers the findings the report named.
